panels.title: Event rate (events/s)
panels.description: Total event-stream rate per bucket — rate() over the whole stream, events per second (the SQL count * 1000 / interval_ms equivalent). The query covers all event_name/category (the event_name/category fields are nominal metadata, not in WHERE).

panels.title: Cache hit (token-weighted / max agent / min agent)

targets.expr: 100 * sum(sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="llm_usage" | unwrap attributes_cache_read [5m])) / sum(sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="llm_usage" | unwrap attributes_in_total [5m]))

100 * max(sum by (agent_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="llm_usage" | agent_id!="" | unwrap attributes_cache_read [5m])) / sum by (agent_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="llm_usage" | agent_id!="" | unwrap attributes_in_total [5m])))

100 * min(sum by (agent_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="llm_usage" | agent_id!="" | unwrap attributes_cache_read [5m])) / sum by (agent_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="llm_usage" | agent_id!="" | unwrap attributes_in_total [5m])))

panels.title: Turn success rate
panels.description: Share of turn_end with ok='true' per bucket — turn-level health (LLM call failures, exhausted retries, and interrupted executions all set ok to false). event_name='turn_end', category='telemetry'.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(count_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="turn_end" | attributes_ok="true" [5m])) / sum(count_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="turn_end" [5m]))

panels.title: Events — What happened (T0+T1)

targets.expr: {service_name="unknown_service"} | json | __error__="" | ((level!~"warning|error|critical" and category="audit") or (level=~"warning|error|critical" or (level!~"warning|error|critical" and category!="audit" and event_name=~"checkpoint_write_failed|claim_cas_lost|claim_cas_lost_exit|compact_turn_aborted|dangling_tool_use_repaired|db_outage_pause|db_outage_reconcile_retry|db_outage_wait|db_pool_acquire_slow|db_pool_acquire_timeout|db_recovered|delivery_stalled|editable_pth_repaired|error_resolved|event_log_drop|exec\\(cancelled\\)|exec\\(failed\\)|exec\\(thread\\-stuck\\)|exec\\(timeout\\)|exec_cancelled|exec_failed|exec_node_timeout|exec_subprocess_killed|exec_timeout|host_dispatcher_bad_channel|host_turn_crashed|host_turn_uncancellable|idle_cas_lost|label_generate_failed|launch_confirm_failed|launch_confirm_task_crashed|launch_force_terminated|llm_cancelled|llm_provider_error|llm_turn_aborted|loki_query_failed|page_restore_failed|page_restore_query_failed|page_serve_dir_missing|pgbouncer_repaired|restart_cas_lost|screen_capture_notify_failed|sse_drop|stream_overloaded_retry|stream_stalled_retry|warning_resolved")))

panels.description: Business audit facts and anomaly rows (exact tier predicate: warnings+ always, audit rows, and declared-anomaly names at info level). JSON parse failures excluded.

panels.title: Events — types
panels.description: Event counts by name, level, and category over the selected dashboard window. Tier is derived by the events API and is not a Loki label, so this query groups only fields Loki stores.

panels.title: Events — raw stream (all, incl. noise)
panels.description: Raw stream for debugging; most rows are internal telemetry. JSON parse failures are excluded.

targets.expr: sum(rate({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="llm_usage" | unwrap attributes_in_total [1m])) + sum(rate({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="llm_usage" | unwrap attributes_out_total [1m])) + sum(rate({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="llm_usage" | unwrap attributes_reasoning [1m]))

panels.title: Input TPS (avg / max agent / min agent)
panels.description: Input throughput = Σ(in_total) ÷ Σ(latency_sec), tok/s. in_total is the log_llm_usage total input tokens (incl. cache_read; ~99.5% cache hits over the last 24h, so input TPS ≈ cache/prefill read throughput). latency is the llm_usage wall-clock (latency_ms). avg = token-weighted over all calls; max/min = the fastest/slowest agent per bucket (agent_id IS NOT NULL, only buckets with valid calls count).

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="llm_usage" | attributes_latency_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_in_total [5m])) / sum(sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="llm_usage" | attributes_latency_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_latency_ms [5m])) * 1000

max(sum by (agent_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="llm_usage" | agent_id!="" | attributes_latency_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_in_total [5m])) / sum by (agent_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="llm_usage" | agent_id!="" | attributes_latency_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_latency_ms [5m])) * 1000)

min(sum by (agent_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="llm_usage" | agent_id!="" | attributes_latency_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_in_total [5m])) / sum by (agent_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="llm_usage" | agent_id!="" | attributes_latency_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_latency_ms [5m])) * 1000)

panels.title: Output TPS (avg / max agent / min agent)
panels.description: Output throughput = Σ(out_total) ÷ Σ(latency_sec), tok/s. out_total is the log_llm_usage total output tokens, incl. reasoning (Anthropic thinking / OpenAI reasoning both count into output_tokens; observe.py does not add them again) — i.e. pure decode generation speed (~79 tok/s measured over the last 24h). latency is the llm_usage wall-clock (latency_ms). avg = token-weighted over all calls; max/min = the fastest/slowest agent per bucket (agent_id IS NOT NULL, only buckets with valid calls count).

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="llm_usage" | attributes_latency_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_out_total [5m])) / sum(sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="llm_usage" | attributes_latency_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_latency_ms [5m])) * 1000

max(sum by (agent_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="llm_usage" | agent_id!="" | attributes_latency_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_out_total [5m])) / sum by (agent_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="llm_usage" | agent_id!="" | attributes_latency_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_latency_ms [5m])) * 1000)

min(sum by (agent_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="llm_usage" | agent_id!="" | attributes_latency_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_out_total [5m])) / sum by (agent_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="llm_usage" | agent_id!="" | attributes_latency_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_latency_ms [5m])) * 1000)

panels.title: Gen-stage output TPS (avg / max agent / min agent)
panels.description: Gen-stage output throughput = Σ(out_total) ÷ Σ(decode_sec), tok/s. decode_ms is the 2026-08-04 new instrumentation (stream last chunk − first chunk arrival, excluding network/queue/prefill); out_total is the log_llm_usage total output tokens (incl. reasoning). Only calls after the decode_ms instrumentation went live are counted (attributes ? 'decode_ms'); non-streaming fallback / empty-stream calls with decode_ms=NULL do not count. avg = token-weighted over all calls; max/min = the fastest/slowest agent per bucket (agent_id IS NOT NULL, only buckets with valid calls count).

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="llm_usage" | attributes_decode_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_out_total [5m])) / sum(sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="llm_usage" | attributes_decode_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_decode_ms [5m])) * 1000

max(sum by (agent_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="llm_usage" | agent_id!="" | attributes_decode_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_out_total [5m])) / sum by (agent_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="llm_usage" | agent_id!="" | attributes_decode_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_decode_ms [5m])) * 1000)

min(sum by (agent_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="llm_usage" | agent_id!="" | attributes_decode_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_out_total [5m])) / sum by (agent_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="llm_usage" | agent_id!="" | attributes_decode_ms!="" | unwrap attributes_decode_ms [5m])) * 1000)

panels.title: LLM cost (USD)
panels.description: LLM call cost per bucket — unwrap of the cost_usd field every llm_usage payload carries (task #2626; the producer computes it from one versioned-catalog quote in shared/lm/pricing.py, unpriced models carry no cost_usd and are skipped). event_name='llm_usage', category='telemetry'.

panels.title: LLM errors
panels.description: LLM failure signals per bucket: llm_provider_error (provider rejection / classification error), stream_stalled_retry (stalled stream retry), llm_turn_aborted (turn aborted after retries exhausted), stream_overloaded_retry (overload retry). The event_name field is spec metadata; the query covers all 4 failure events (all telemetry).

panels.title: Per-agent LLM usage (Top 20)
panels.description: Per-agent LLM call count / in / out tokens / cost (window-accumulated; cost via the cost_usd payload field, same as the LLM cost panel; agents without cost_usd count NULL). Restores the retired Metrics page's per-agent breakdown table (2026-08-06 user request: 'bring back the big pile of metrics like SDK calls'). event_name='llm_usage', category='telemetry', Top 20 by cost descending. One instant target per column; Grafana joins them on the shared agent_id label.

targets.expr: sum by (agent_id) (count_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="llm_usage" | agent_id!="" [$__range]))
sum by (agent_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="llm_usage" | agent_id!="" | unwrap attributes_in_total [$__range]))
sum by (agent_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="llm_usage" | agent_id!="" | unwrap attributes_out_total [$__range]))
sum by (agent_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="llm_usage" | agent_id!="" | unwrap attributes_cost_usd [$__range]))
max by (attributes_route) (max_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category=~"telemetry|log" | event_name="gateway_latency" | unwrap attributes_p95_ms [1m]))
max by (attributes_route) (max_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category=~"telemetry|log" | event_name="gateway_latency" | unwrap attributes_p99_ms [1m]))

panels.title: Turn duration (p50/p95)
panels.description: p50 and p95 of the Prometheus ava_turn_end_duration_seconds histogram. The p95 uses the same source and quantile as alert rule R18: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(ava_turn_end_duration_seconds_bucket[10m]))).

panels.title: Gateway latency sample count by route

targets.expr: max by (attributes_route) (max_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category=~"telemetry|log" | event_name="gateway_latency" | unwrap attributes_count [1m]))

panels.title: Exec outcomes
panels.description: Exec outcome breakdown per bucket: ok = event_name='exec'; failures split by event_name (exec_failed / exec(timeout) / exec(cancelled) / exec_node_timeout, legacy parenthesized spellings counted in; unknown exec* events fall into other). event_name='exec', category='telemetry'.

panels.title: Syntax fix triggers (by kind)
panels.description: Syntax-fix trigger counts per bucket, bucketed by the fix kinds in attributes.fixes (substring regex matching; an event with several fix kinds counts once per kind, 'none'/null/unknown goes to other). event_name='syntax_fix', category='telemetry' (90d retention).

panels.title: Halt classes
panels.description: Halt events classified by body per bucket: idle ('no tool_call (idle)'), compact ('system_halt (compact)'), lifecycle ('lifecycle AgentTermination / AgentRestart'), other. event_name='halt', category='telemetry'.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="halt" | attributes_body!="no tool_call (idle)" | attributes_body!~".*compact.*" | attributes_body!~"lifecycle .*" [5m]))

panels.title: SDK calls (Top 20)
panels.description: Top 20 sdk_call grouped by attributes.fn — runtime call-frequency ranking, replacing the retired Metrics page's sdk_usage text ranking. event_name='sdk_call', category='telemetry'. Table panel (instant query over the whole window).

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (attributes_fn) (count_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="sdk_call" [$__range])) * 10)

panels.title: Frontend interactions
panels.description: Frontend interaction volume per bucket (total frontend_interaction events): the entry panel of user-modeling telemetry, doubling as volume monitoring — an abnormal interaction spike (an instrumentation loop bug) is immediately visible here. event_name='frontend_interaction', category='telemetry', source='user'.

panels.title: Frontend interactions (Top 15 elements)
panels.description: Top 15 in-window interactions grouped by attributes.element — ranking of the interaction points users click/trigger most (spawn/composer-send/setting-change/page-view/...). event_name='frontend_interaction', category='telemetry'.

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (attributes_element) (count_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="frontend_interaction" | source="user" [$__range])))

panels.title: Frontend page views (Top 15)
panels.description: Top 15 in-window page views (element='page-view') grouped by attributes.page — which screens users spend the most time on. event_name='frontend_interaction', category='telemetry'.

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (attributes_page) (count_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="frontend_interaction" | source="user" | attributes_element="page-view" [$__range])))

panels.title: Settings changes (Top 15)
panels.description: Top 15 in-window user setting changes (element='setting-change') grouped by attributes.key — which settings/layout/preferences users adjusted (display.* / behavior.* keys). event_name='frontend_interaction', category='telemetry'.

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (attributes_key) (count_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="frontend_interaction" | source="user" | attributes_element="setting-change" [$__range])))

panels.title: Agent spawns (window, by source)
panels.description: Windowed spawn totals grouped by source. event_name='spawn', category='audit'.

panels.title: Agent lifecycle (window)
panels.description: Windowed lifecycle totals grouped by event name. category='audit'.

panels.title: Delivery stalled (window)
panels.description: Windowed delivery_stalled total. event_name='delivery_stalled', category='telemetry'.

panels.title: Syntax fix count
panels.description: Syntax_fix events over time — how often the repair pipeline fixes syntax errors in LLM-produced code (event_name='syntax_fix', category='telemetry', 90d retention).

panels.title: Syntax fixes (window)
panels.description: Total syntax_fix events in the current window (event_name='syntax_fix', category='telemetry').

panels.title: Task completion rate
panels.description: Share of task_update events with status='done' — only updates carrying a status count toward the denominator (event_name='task_update', category='audit').

targets.expr: 100 * sum(count_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="audit" | event_name="task_update" | attributes_status="done" [5m])) / sum(count_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="audit" | event_name="task_update" | attributes_status!="" [5m]))

panels.title: Memory recall filter runs
panels.description: Recall_filter INFO events over time — how often passive memory recall filters retrieval results for relevance (event_name='recall_filter', level='info', category='telemetry', 90d retention).

panels.title: Empty recall ratio
panels.description: Share of INFO runs where filtering kept 0 notes (body 'N candidate(s) -> 0 kept') — recall-quality signal: a high share means retrieval/filtering usually judges nothing relevant (event_name='recall_filter', category='telemetry').

targets.expr: 100 * sum(count_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category=~"telemetry|log" | event_name="recall_filter" | level="info" | attributes_body =~ ".*-> 0 kept.*" [5m])) / sum(count_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category=~"telemetry|log" | event_name="recall_filter" | level="info" [5m]))

panels.title: Recall filter error ratio
panels.description: Share of recall_filter WARNINGs across all runs — when the filter call fails (model error / timeout / unparseable reply) the round's recall injection is empty; a spiking rate points at the filter model or provider (event_name='recall_filter', category='telemetry').

targets.expr: 100 * sum(count_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category=~"telemetry|log" | event_name="recall_filter" | level="warning" [5m])) / sum(count_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category=~"telemetry|log" | event_name="recall_filter" [5m]))

panels.title: Recall filter failures (window)
panels.description: Total recall_filter WARNINGs in the current window — filter unavailable, an unparseable reply, or an unknown model path all leave the round without injection (event_name='recall_filter', category='telemetry').

panels.title: CPU utilization
panels.description: Non-idle CPU averaged over the machine's cores. Alert R8 fires above 0.90 sustained 15m.

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: Used fraction of RAM, reclaimable cache excluded — real pressure. Alert R9 above 0.90 sustained 15m.

panels.title: Load average
panels.description: Runnable-thread load. Compare against the machine's core count, which the CPU panel normalizes away.

panels.title: Filesystem used
panels.description: Per-mountpoint fullness — the pg data dir, the traces mirror and the LGTM volumes live on these. Alert R10 above 0.90. On macOS every volume of one APFS container reports the container's fullness.

panels.title: Disk throughput
panels.description: Bytes read/written per second across all devices.

panels.title: Network throughput
panels.description: Bytes per second across physical + tunnel interfaces (the sidecar filters macOS's virtual ones out).

panels.title: Postgres connections
panels.description: Open backends against the server's own max_connections. Alert R11 fires above 80% of max. PgBouncer has no OTel receiver — pool saturation surfaces here, at Postgres.

panels.title: Postgres transactions
panels.description: Commit and rollback rate. A rollback rate tracking the commit rate means transactions are failing, not that traffic is low.

panels.title: Database size
panels.description: On-disk size of the cluster's own database — the slow half of the disk-watermark story.

panels.title: Redis memory
panels.description: Resident Redis footprint. Alert R12 fires above 2 GiB sustained; rss above used means fragmentation.

panels.title: Redis clients and evictions
panels.description: Any eviction rate above zero means Redis hit maxmemory and is dropping live keys — cluster state loss, not a cache miss.

panels.title: Redis throughput
panels.description: Commands per second, as Redis itself reports it.
Projected full-day LLM spend from usage-time cost snapshots over the dashboard time window. Formula: window spend × 86,400 / elapsed seconds in the panel range.

panels.description: Projected 30-day LLM spend from usage-time cost snapshots over the dashboard time window. Formula: window spend × 2,592,000 / elapsed seconds in the panel range.
panels.title: LLM cost estimate — 30-day pace

panels.description: Usage-time LLM cost snapshots grouped into $__interval buckets over the dashboard time window.

panels.description: Top 20 models by windowed usage-time cost snapshots. The model name is the llm_usage payload's attributes_model label.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (attributes_model) (sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="llm_usage" | attributes_model!="" | unwrap attributes_cost_usd [$__range])))

panels.description: Top 20 agents by windowed usage-time LLM cost snapshots.
panels.title: LLM cost by agent (Top 20)

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (agent_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="unknown_service"} | json | category="telemetry" | event_name="llm_usage" | agent_id!="" | unwrap attributes_cost_usd [$__range])))
